proposals.title: Ride, settle
proposals.direction: r003-03 without the bounce: the capsule grows and the pinned button rides its corner on a plain ease-out (380 ms), stopping dead at its dock. No overshoot, no squash; slide in/out and the hairline unchanged.

proposals.title: Ride, glide
proposals.direction: The same ride on a symmetric ease-in-out (480 ms): the card opens like a drawer, accelerating and decelerating evenly, the button travelling with the corner. The calmest and most deliberate of the three.

proposals.title: Ride, snap
proposals.direction: The same ride, quick: ease-out-quint over 240 ms, so the card is open almost before the key comes up. Motion as confirmation only, the least visible of the three.
